name: STC-2216GP-2BT.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STC-2216GP-2BT
Product Name	20 port 10/100/1000Mbps Ethernet BT PoE Switch
Fixed Port	16*10/100/1000Base-TX PoE port (Data/Power) / 2*10/100/1000Base-TX uplink RJ45 port (Data) / 2*1000M SFP
PoE Ports	1-2 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, max 90W PoE out / 3-16 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, max 30W/port, PoE out
PoE Pin	af/at: 12+ 36- / af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Function	N: Standard normal / V: Port isolation / C: Flow control mode
PoE Budget	Max 300W
Bandwidth	56Gbps
Packet Forwarding	41.67Mpps
MAC	8K
Buffer	4.1M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	POWER: Power LED / 19-20: SFP connection indicator / Uplink: 10/100M=Green Link, 1000M=Orange Link / Downlink: 10/100M=Green Link, 1000M=Orange Link
Power	Built-in power AC: 100-240VAC 50-60Hz
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-10°C～+55°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 293mm*190mm*45mm / Packing Box: 410mm*278mm*95mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	1.7Kg/2.4Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us / IP30
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	1 Year
